contact.department: Wake County GIS Services (Department of Information Services)

counties.notes: Wake County (Raleigh metro, pop. 1.17 million) hosts 435,382 parcel polygons in its county-direct ArcGIS FeatureServer. Owner-name queries use UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '%SMITH%' and return real site addresses (verified 2026-05-11). Two identifiers matter: PIN_NUM is a 10-digit code derived from State Plane grid coordinates and uniquely locates the parcel geographically; REID (Real Estate ID) is the assessor's account key, used by the Wake County Register of Deeds and the iMAPS application for cross-reference. The layer also carries OLD_PARCEL_NUMBER for reconciling legacy records that predate current PIN_NUM assignment. Wake County GIS and Raleigh GIS jointly maintain iMAPS (maps.raleighnc.gov/iMAPS) as a parallel lookup tool supporting owner, address, PIN, and REID searches. NC OneMap aggregates Wake data quarterly as well; the county's own FeatureServer is more current for recent splits and consolidations.

contact.department: Mecklenburg County GIS, Geospatial Information Services (Charlotte-Mecklenburg joint GIS)

counties.notes: Mecklenburg County (Charlotte, pop. 1.2M) GIS endpoint is hosted on Charlotte's ArcGIS server (gis.charlottenc.gov). 13 fields on this public layer: OBJECTID, MAP_BOOK, MAP_PAGE, MAP_BLOCK, LOT_NUM, NC_PIN, PID, PARCEL_TYPE, CONDO_TOWN_FLAG, Legal_From, Shape. NOTE: Owner name and address are NOT exposed on this public REST endpoint. The Charlotte/Mecklenburg POLARIS system provides owner-name lookups at polaris3g.mecklenburgcountync.gov but does not expose a public REST API. For parcel + owner data, Mecklenburg County's Geospatial Information Services (GIS) division provides full POLARIS data through the county open mapping site. This endpoint is geometry + PIN only.

contact.department: NC OneMap / NC Geographic Information Coordinating Council (GICC), statewide parcel layer

counties.notes: Forsyth County (Winston-Salem, pop. 385,000) is served via the NC Geographic Information Coordinating Council's NC1Map statewide parcel aggregation (services.gis.nc.gov). Filter by cntyfips='067' (3-digit string). Key fields: parno (parcel number), ownname/ownname2 (owner names), siteadd/scity/szip (site address), mailadd/mcity/mstate/mzip (mailing address), parval (total parcel value), landval, improvval, gisacres, parusecode/parusedesc (land use), saledate, legdecfull (legal description), subdivisio, owntype, and cntyname. The NC1Map layer is updated quarterly from county submissions to the GICC. Forsyth County also maintains MapForsyth (mapforsyth.org), a county-direct open data portal with weekly-updated parcel and address layers -- for the most current data, MapForsyth is the better path. The county Tax Assessor's Geo-Data Explorer (forsyth.cc/tax/geodata.aspx) provides parcel search by address, owner, and parcel ID.

contact.department: NC OneMap / NC Geographic Information Coordinating Council (GICC), statewide parcel layer

counties.notes: Guilford County (Greensboro and High Point metro, pop. 540,000) is served via the NC1Map statewide parcel aggregation (services.gis.nc.gov). Filter by cntyfips='081'. The same field schema applies as other NC1Map counties: ownname/ownname2, siteadd/scity/szip, mailadd/mcity, parval, landval, improvval, parusecode/parusedesc, saledate, and legdecfull. Guilford covers two large municipalities -- Greensboro and High Point -- whose parcel data are both captured in this single county layer; the scity field distinguishes them. Guilford County GIS Hub (gcgis.guilfordcountync.gov) exposes boundary and road layers but not the full parcel-plus-owner REST path; NC1Map remains the only public REST route for owner-level queries. Verified 2026-05-15: cntyfips='081' returns Greensboro and High Point addresses. Quarterly update cycle from county to GICC may lag recent deed recordings by up to 3 months.

contact.department: City-County GIS (Durham City + Durham County joint)

counties.notes: Durham County (Research Triangle, pop. 330,000) provides its parcel layer via a City/County joint GIS operation separate from NC1Map. The layer exposes 75+ confirmed fields. Key identifiers: PIN (parcel identification number) and REID (real estate ID, the assessor account key). PROPERTY_OWNER uses a semicolon-delimited format for co-owners (e.g., 'SMITH, CAROLYN D;SMITH, FRANK Q'). Address fields include LOCATION_ADDR and PHYADDR_CITY/STATE/ZIP for the site, plus OWNER_MAIL_1/2/3/CITY/STATE/ZIP/PLUS_4 for the mailing address. Valuation fields include TOTAL_LAND_VALUE_ASSESSED, TOTAL_BLDG_VALUE_ASSESSED, and TOTAL_PROP_VALUE. Deed fields DEED_DATE, DEED_BOOK, and DEED_PAGE point directly to recorded instruments. ZONING, LAND_CLASS, and TOWNSHIP provide planning context. Verified 2026-05-15: PROPERTY_OWNER queries return Durham addresses. For fuller record detail, the Durham County Tax Administration property search at dconc.gov is the authoritative portal.

contact.department: NC OneMap / NC Geographic Information Coordinating Council (GICC), statewide parcel layer

counties.notes: Cumberland County (Fayetteville, pop. 335,000; includes Fort Liberty, formerly Fort Bragg) is served via the NC1Map statewide parcel aggregation (services.gis.nc.gov). Filter by cntyfips='051'. The NC1Map field schema applies: ownname/ownname2, siteadd/scity/szip, mailadd/mcity/mstate/mzip, parval, landval, improvval, parusecode/parusedesc, saledate, and legdecfull. Cumberland's parcel inventory includes the substantial federal footprint of Fort Liberty; military installation parcels typically appear with US Government as owner and may carry limited attribute data. The county seat Fayetteville and surrounding municipalities like Spring Lake and Hope Mills are fully covered. Quarterly update cycle from county to GICC applies. For current ownership, the Cumberland County Tax Administration portal at co.cumberland.nc.us handles property search by owner, address, and parcel ID. Cumberland County also maintains an open data portal at opendata.co.cumberland.nc.us with downloadable parcel layers.

Buncombe County (Asheville, pop. 275,000) hosts its parcel layer on a county-direct ArcGIS service. The service name is property_bc_dis (dis = district); layer 1 of 3 is the parcel polygon layer (layer 0 is County Boundary, layer 2 is Street Centerline). The primary parcel identifier is pinnum, a 15-digit number. The owner field is named owner (lowercase). Building fields include HouseNumber, NumberSuffix, TaxYear, DeedBook, DeedPage, PlatBook, PlatPage, SubName, SubLot, SubBlock, SubSect, CondoUnit, and CondoBuilding. Data is refreshed daily at 6 a.m. on weekdays from CAMA sources. Verified 2026-05-15: SMITH returns Asheville-area addresses. Buncombe County's GIS portal (gis.buncombenc.gov/buncomap) is the primary web interface. For assessment detail, the SpatialEst Property Record Search at prc-buncombe.spatialest.com is the county-linked assessor lookup. Hurricane Helene (September 2024) caused significant disruptions in Asheville; some parcels in flood-affected areas may carry amended ownership or assessment data.

contact.department: NC OneMap / NC Geographic Information Coordinating Council (GICC), statewide parcel layer

counties.notes: Montgomery County, North Carolina (Troy; FIPS 37123) is served via the NC OneMap statewide parcel aggregation (NC1Map_Parcels), the same layer as the other North Carolina records, filtered by cntyname = 'Montgomery' (30,283 rows, the same count as cntyfips = '123'; every one has an owner, on 2026-10-08; the control county Forsyth, cntyfips '067', answers with 166,755 rows and 166,755 owners). Key fields: parno (parcel number, for example '7568 11 56 4434'), ownname/ownname2 (owner names), siteadd (site address, often the street only without a number, e.g. 'EMERALD SHORES RD'), mailadd/mcity/mstate/mzip (mailing address), parval, landval, improvval, gisacres, saledate, cntyname, cntyfips. scity IS BLANK in the sampled Montgomery rows, so match addresses on siteadd and not on the city. revisedate and saledate are null for Montgomery and the layer publishes no editingInfo, so the vintage of this county's roll cannot be dated from the service. The layer allows 5,000 rows per page with pagination and answers cross-origin requests (the server echoes the request Origin). The service lives under /secure/rest and sets an AGS_ROLES cookie, as it does for the other North Carolina records. Verified 2026-10-08: owner SMITH returned rows (for example 6574 11 65 0218, SMITH MICHAEL C, EMERALD SHORES RD); a MAIN ST site search returned 7568 11 56 4434, JUNIPER PROPERTIES LLC, 327 WEST MAIN ST; a point query at -79.8999,35.3633 returned 7538 05 18 6219, LYNTHACUM JESSE, 508 ELDORADO ST.

contact.department: Gaston County Tax Office, Tax GIS Mapping Division (704-810-5827)

counties.notes: Gaston County, North Carolina (Gastonia; FIPS 37071). The county publishes its parcels with CAMA (appraisal) attributes on its own ArcGIS Server as PublicGIS/Parcels MapServer layer 11 ('Parcels'; the service has only this layer, and its id is 11, not 0): 118,132 parcels on 2026-10-10, 118,090 of them with a current owner. THREE OWNER VINTAGES ARE PUBLISHED SIDE BY SIDE: CURR_NAME1/CURR_NAME2 with CURR_ADDR1, CURR_ADDR2, CURR_CITY, CURR_STATE and CURR_ZIPCODE are the CURRENT owner and mailing address; JAN1_NAME1/JAN1_NAME2 are the owner of record on January 1 (the tax-listing date); PRVYRNAME1/PRVYRNAME2 are the prior year's owner. This record uses only the CURR_ columns. The JAN1_ and PRVYR_ columns are deliberately not listed, because the field classifier takes the first owner-like column it sees, and on 2026-10-10 CURR_NAME1 differed from JAN1_NAME1 on 28,965 rows (about 25%, which includes formatting differences as well as sales). The situs is WHOLE_ADDRESS (also PHYSSTRADD), with POSTAL (postal city), STATE and ZIP (a number); WHOLE_ADDRESS is blank on 16,130 rows (about 14%). CURR_ZIPCODE is five or nine digits with no hyphen. The parcel id is PIN, the NC map PIN (dddd-dd-dddd), with the CAMA account number in PID and AKPAR. The layer also carries the last sale date and amount, fair market values, deed book and page, plat book and page, legal description, building characteristics and a flood-area figure. Currency: last_edited_date and SALEDATE both peak at 2026-10-08, and parcel_year is 2027 on every row. CORS: no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is sent, with or without an Origin header and on the preflight, so a browser on another site cannot read it and corsEnabled is false; query it from a server, the metered API or the MCP. maxRecordCount is 10,000 with pagination. The service description says only that it displays parcel boundaries with the DevNet CAMA table; no license or terms text is published on the service. A separate City of Gastonia parcel service (cogserver.gastonianc.gov) is city-run and is not used. Verified 2026-10-10: a count, resultRecordCount=1, an owner LIKE query on CURR_NAME1 (1,192 rows for %SMITH%), a situs LIKE query on MAIN ST (922 rows) and a point query at the county's internal point (one parcel, with an owner).
